name: Level-synchronized bisection ray casting
definition: A robust ray casting algorithm that renders the zero-level-set of an implicit function f: R^3 -> R using interval arithmetic to guarantee no surface features are missed. It processes all active rays in lockstep by depth level, using interval evaluation to exclude intervals that cannot contain a zero crossing, and bisection to refine the hit location.
summary: Level-synchronized bisection ray casting renders implicit surfaces by processing all active rays in lockstep using interval arithmetic to guarantee no surface features are missed.
